To get plain text without markup, you can parse the string with `Text.from_markup()` and read `.plain`:

```python
from rich.text import Text

Text.from_markup("[red]Foo[/red] [bold]bar[/bold]").plain  # "Foo bar"
```

See [markup](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) for how tags are parsed. Related: #2016.

For general usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
